3 days ago 26 applicants
[See who Silva's Painting has hired for this role](https://www.linkedin.com/login?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Elinkedin%2Ecom%2Fsearch%2Fresults%2Fpeople%2F%3FfacetCurrentCompany%3D9475103%26title%3DGeneral%2BManager&emailAddress=&fromSignIn=&trk=public_jobs_see-who-was-hired_people-search-link_face-pile-cta)
Apply [Save](https://www.linkedin.com/login?emailAddress=&fromSignIn=&session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fjobs%2Fview%2Fgeneral-manager-at-silva-s-painting-4481725680&trk=public_jobs)
* [Report this job](https://www.linkedin.com/uas/login?fromSignIn=true&session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fjobs%2Fview%2Fgeneral-manager-at-silva-s-painting-4481725680&trk=public_jobs_ellipsis-menu-semaphore-sign-in-redirect&guestReportContentType=JOB&_f=guest-reporting)
We’re Hiring: General Manager | Commercial Painting | Orlando, FL
Silva’s Painting & General Services is looking for an experienced General Manager to help lead our company into its next stage of growth.
We’ve built a successful commercial painting business with approximately 20 years of operating history. Now, we’re looking for a proven leader who can take ownership of our day-to-day operations, strengthen our management structure, and help us continue to grow.
This is more than a project management role.
Our General Manager will work directly with ownership and oversee Operations, Estimating, and Administration, with responsibility for the overall financial and operational performance of the business.
What we’re looking for:
• 10+ years of commercial painting experience
• Experience working within a larger commercial painting operation, ideally $15M+ in annual revenue
• Strong knowledge of P&L management, budgeting, job costing, margins, and financial performance
• Experience overseeing operations, estimating, and project execution
• Understanding of labor productivity, scheduling, accounts receivable, and profitability
• Commercial repaint and/or new-construction painting experience
• A proven ability to lead people, develop managers, and create accountability
• Strong communication, decision-making, and relationship-building skills
• A history of stability and long-term impact with previous employers
What makes this opportunity different?
We’re looking for someone who wants the opportunity to truly help run and shape a business.
You’ll have meaningful authority to improve systems, strengthen processes, develop our team, and help build an organization that can continue scaling successfully.
We’re proud of what we’ve built. We’re equally excited about where we can go next with the right leader in place.
📍 Orlando, FL
💰 $125,000-$135,000 base salary + performance incentive + benefits
🏗️ Full-Time | Commercial Painting
If you’ve built your career in commercial painting and are ready to take on broader leadership and business ownership, we’d like to hear from you.
Apply today to start the conversation.
**Additional Job Application Terms**
This job is part of LinkedIn’s Full-Service Hiring beta program. Eligibility is limited to candidates located in and performing services in the United States, excluding those based in Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, South Carolina, or West Virginia.
We’re committed to making our hiring process as smooth and timely as possible, and we understand that waiting to hear back can add to the anticipation. If you’re a potential fit, our team will reach out within two weeks to progress you to the next stage.
If you don’t hear from us in that time, we encourage you to explore other opportunities with our team in the future, and we wish you the very best in your job search.
* Seniority level
  Mid-Senior level
* Employment type
  Full-time
* Industries
  Construction

NDT Operations Manager

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced **NDT Operations Manager** to oversee the daily operations, technical performance, and continued growth of an established Nondestructive Testing (NDT) laboratory in Hollywood, Florida.

...

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in NDT, experience supervising technicians, and knowledge of industry certification and quality requirements. Experience in aerospace, defense, or industrial testing environments is highly desirable.

...

* Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or industrial testing environments preferred.

* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with budgeting, operational reporting, or P&L management preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent technical experience will be considered.
NDT Certifications & Technical Experience
ASNT NDT Level III certification is highly desirable. Experience with multiple NDT methods is preferred, including:
* **MT** – Magnetic Particle Testing
* **PT** – Liquid Penetrant Testing
* **RT** – Radiographic Testing
* **ET** – Eddy Current Testing
* **UT** – Ultrasonic Testing
* **VT** – Visual Testing
* **GPR** – Ground Penetrating Radar

Join to save **General Manager (GM) of CTI Door Components** at **Composite Technology International, Inc.**
* [Report this job](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/ask/TS-RIC-LO?entityUrn=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fjobs%2Fview%2Fgeneral-manager-gm-of-cti-door-components-at-composite-technology-international-inc-4481294822)
At Composite Technology International (CTI), we design, develop, and deliver millwork products and door components for building product manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. We create integral components needed for finished products such as mouldings, frames, jambs, and pre-hung doors.
CTI’s Atlanta Production Facility meets growing demand for domestically produced door components with fast lead times and flexible customizations.
The 108,069 SF plant is operated with a highly skilled team of approximately 30 employees and focuses on the high-mix, low-volume precision fabrication of specialized jambs, frames, mouldings, sills, and astragals. Additional information about CTI can be found on our website at www.cti-web.com.
As the General Manager (GM) of CTI Door Components, you will provide strategic leadership, operational direction, and full P&L ownership for our made-to-order (MTO) door component manufacturing facility.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on expert who can effectively manage splitting time between high-level business strategy and direct daily management.
This position requires a unique leader who can optimize a sprawling floor layout and material logistics, foster a close-knit, highly skilled workforce with specialized training, minimize production lead times, and protect profit margins on highly variable orders.
At CTI, we believe a successful career isn’t defined solely by a degree. We place primary value on those with deep, practical manufacturing experience, proven operational leadership, and a strong work ethic. No degree is required.
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Facility Logistics & Made-to-Order Operations**
* **Sprawling Layout Optimization:** Manage the physical footprint, material staging, and internal logistics of the 108,069 SF facility to minimize material handling times.
* **High-Mix Production Scheduling:** Direct the dynamic scheduling of machining and component assembly lines to seamlessly handle an influx of varying dimensions and customizations daily.
* **Workforce Cross-Training:** Maximize the agility of the 30-person production team by implementing robust cross-training programs, ensuring a lean workforce can dynamically pivot and cover a large physical plant as order mixes change.
* **Agile Materials Management:** Oversee procurement and flexible inventory strategies for imported raw materials (frames, brickmold, weatherstrip, sills, and astragals) to match irregular demands without bloating warehouse storage.
**Engineering, Detailing, & Material Yield**
* **Order-to-Floor Synergy:** Ensure seamless coordination between sales, CAD detailers, and the production floor to guarantee that custom component dimensions and machining tolerances translate perfectly to CNC machinery.
* **Yield & Waste Management:** Implement strict optimization protocols to minimize expensive raw material drop-off and scrap costs on unique runs.
**Quality Assurance & Precision Control**
* **Dimensional Accuracy:** Establish stringent quality gates at critical machining stations to prevent dimensional drift, moisture content issues, or structural errors before components reach final inspection.
* **Industry Benchmarks:** Maintain strict manufacturing compliance with custom industry benchmarks, ensuring products meet premium millwork integrity standards.
**Financial Control & Culture Leadership**
* **P&L and Costing Oversight:** Manage the plant’s operational budget, labor costs, utilities, and CapEx investments for a large facility. Constantly audit actual production costs against front-end custom quoting to protect profit margins.
* **Culture & Safety:** Foster a transparent, high-accountability culture across the 30-person facility.
Maintain an uncompromising safety culture across the large physical space, ensuring complete compliance with OSHA regulations and targeted reduction of incidents.
**Role Requirements & Qualifications:**
* 5+ years of progressive plant leadership experience, specifically managing made-to-order millwork or job-shop manufacturing environments.
* No degree required. Extensive, real-world, hands-on manufacturing leadership and equivalent industry expertise are highly valued.
* Direct experience managing large-scale industrial space (~100,000 sq.
ft.) with a proven track record of optimizing facility layouts, material flow, and multi-station logistics.
* Proven ability to lead and manage a compact, agile workforce (~30 employees) with an emphasis on cross-training and employee retention.
* Practical experience in door components, architectural millwork, or advanced secondary manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with complex ERP/MRP systems and CNC configuration software capable of handling dynamic Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Advanced grasp of Lean Manufacturing applied to low-volume, high-variety component fabrication (e.g., cell manufacturing, pull systems, single-piece flow).
**Benefits:**
* Benefits include very generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees (dependent coverage is available at a subsidized cost), a generous health reimbursement (HRA) plan, a 401(k) plan with a 3% company contribution, 3 weeks of paid time off and 10 company holidays, and professional development support.
* Seniority level
Executive
* Employment type
Full-time
* Industries
Wholesale Building Materials

**Description
** Guests of the Marquesa Hotel often speak of its effortless luxury and calming sense of home, which is no coincidence. Long before becoming a hotel, these buildings were luxe private homes. Every accommodation, parlor, garden and porch has offered refuge and relaxation since their founding.
The Marquesa Hotel continues to welcome guests with the same sense of warmth today.
We are currently seeking a strong leader to serve as the new face of this beautiful location. As the General Manager you will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, and successful operation of the hotel.
Make an impact by overseeing all aspects of hotel performance, including guest satisfaction, financial results, employee engagement, sales and revenue growth, operational excellence, and asset preservation.
In this crucial role, you will serve as the property's senior leader, fostering a culture of service excellence, accountability, and teamwork while ensuring alignment with brand standards and ownership objectives.
**Key Responsibilities:
**
* Lead all operational managers to success on daily, weekly, monthly, and annual action plans related to the property's strategic plan.
* Champion the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensure alignment amongst the property Leadership team.
* Plan, organize, facilitate, attend, and/or participate in various hotel and departmental meetings. Ensure compliance of brand standard operating procedures and policies.
* Develop and manage execution of all budgets and revenue forecasts.
* Develop and implement controls for expense management, such as utilizing labor management tools.
* Interview, hire, train, develop, recommend performance evaluations, resolve problems, and recommend discipline and/or termination when appropriate of staff members.
* As a member of the Executive Committee for the property, the General Manager is expected to help create and execute the financial objectives of the hotel.
* Drive key customer relationships through personal involvement in the sales process.
* Ensure that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
* Be highly visible and interface with guests on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, services levels, and overall satisfaction.
* Maintain a professional and personable appearance at all times, according to hotel standards.
* All other duties as requested.
**You own this if you have...
**
* Previous leadership experience as a General Manager at a luxury hotel/resort environment.
* Immersion in the following resort divisions highly desirable: Food & Beverage, Front Desk and/or Rooms, Spa.
* Demonstrated facilitation of organizational change management, particularly in a long-standing, independent resort or property.
**The Offer** : In return and in addition to offering a truly rare career opportunity, you are rewarded with a competitive compensation package to include competitive pay, bonus potential, matching 401k, health benefits, generous travel discounts, paid time off, and the opportunity to lead a team in paradise. **Discounted employee housing available.
** **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Include but not limited to
**
* Guest Satisfaction Scores
* Employee Engagement and Retention
* RevPAR Growth
* ADR Performance
* GOP and EBITDA Performance
* Labor Cost Management
**Physical Requirements:
**
* Push/Pull/Lift 50+ pounds.
* Endure various physical movements throughout the work areas.
* Remain in stationary and mobile positions for 8 hours throughout the work shift.
* Ability to walk and stand for extended periods throughout the property.
**Requirements
**
* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
**Experience
**
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive hotel leadership experience in a senior hotel leadership role such as General Manager, Resort Manager, Hotel Manager, or Director of Operations.
* Experience with resort or luxury hotel operations preferred.
**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
**
* Strong leadership and team development skills.
* Demonstrated financial acumen and budget management expertise.
* Proven ability to drive guest satisfaction and operational performance.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
* Create a culture where employees want to stay and grow.
* Balance owner expectations with associate experience.
* Serve as the face of the property within the community.
* Ability to respond to operational issues and emergencies outside of normal business hours.
_Noble House Hotels & Resorts are proud to encourage and support an environment where everyone can be a successful team member (come as they are) as their true authentic self.

### Senior Executive Recruiter at Cornerstone Executive Search | Honoring God in all I do by serving others with Integrity, Optimism & Stewardship.
Molycop manufactures forged grinding media used by mining customers in mineral processing. Its U.S. business combines manufacturing in Kansas City with commercial, technical and supply chain capabilities that serve customers across the United States and Panama.
The Kansas City operation has an experienced, collaborative and largely self-directed team. It is part of a global business, with country leaders contributing to shared strategy while taking ownership of local decisions and results. The General Manager will draw on Molycop’s global resources and technical expertise while leading the U.S.

...

The role oversees the Kansas City manufacturing operation and the commercial, technical, supply chain, finance, human resources, quality, health, safety, environmental and community-facing activities that support it.
The General Manager sets the local direction within Molycop’s global strategy and works with a strong functional leadership team to deliver safe, reliable operations, customer value and sustained financial performance. The scope excludes Molycop’s Gainesville technology operation and the Canadian business.
The Ideal Candidate

...

A commercial orientation is especially valuable, paired with enough operational and financial fluency to lead a manufacturing business with full P&L responsibility. Experience in either heavy industrial manufacturing, such as steel or forging, or the mining market is important; direct grinding media experience is a plus.

...

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience and Capabilities**

...

**Preferred Background**
* Exposure to steel, metals, forging, mining consumables, capital-intensive manufacturing or mineral processing customers.
* Master’s degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, finance or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and leadership experience.
* Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or related continuous improvement practices.

...

* Be based in the Kansas City area and remain visible and accessible at the manufacturing operation.
* Travel periodically for global strategy meetings, supplier and customer visits, and other business needs; travel is expected to be limited overall.

...

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Cornerstone Executive Search by 2x
